pages.text: $(l)Can I drink the saline?$() No.$(br2)$(l)Can a jar sit in the chair?$() No, but it can look at the panel.$(br2)$(l)Can my body take a portal?$() Only carrying its head, or over an Entangled Pair. A jar takes any.

$(l)What if my jar breaks?$() A real death: modules, goggles and collar drop, and you respawn whole. The jar menu's Let Go button does this on purpose.$(br)$(l)Can I saw a colleague?$() No. Nor bosses, named creatures, others' pets or hosts.
